description: A language-agnostic 7-step debugging protocol (reproduce -） locate the layer -） minimize -） hypothesize -） verify -） fix -） regress) with a zero-dependency, offline toolchain that turns 'I reproduced it' into checkable evidence: triage extracts exception type, last stack frame, exit code, HTTP status and timestamps from raw logs; envsnap builds a paste-ready environment block with every key containing KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASS/CRED/AUTH/COOKIE redacted; reprocheck grades the five minimum elements of a reproduction report and names the missing ones. Ships a 10-case golden set with a re-executable runner, a real error-log demo, a layered symptom lookup, a 5-item pre-delivery self-check and degradation rules. Faithful by design: no unobserved cause is ever invented, and any claim lacking reproducible evidence is explicitly marked unconfirmed. Generic methodology tool - not a medical device, no clinical or efficacy claims.
